title: Acceptance tests fused to the MCP transport (no DSL / protocol-driver layer)
evidence: tests/test_sample_questions.py:36 opens `async with Client(server.mcp)` inline and each case hard-codes the tool name + args; test_server.py repeats the asyncio.run/Client dance per test. _atdd_review.md Priority 1.
suggestion: Extract a single SoccerDriver owning MCP/asyncio/is_error/content-unwrap, and a thin domain DSL, so transport changes touch one place.

title: Wall-clock latency assertions sit in the releasable test gate (flakiness risk)
evidence: tests/test_performance.py: `assert _timed(getattr(q, method), **kwargs) < 2`; simple-lookup cases run on the shared warm-cache `q` fixture so timing depends on test order. _atdd_review.md Priority 3.
suggestion: Mark these `@pytest.mark.perf` and run them as a separate benchmark job with generous headroom, so a loaded host can't turn a green build red.

title: Acceptance cases assert exact rendered output strings and pin the tool choice
evidence: tests/test_sample_questions.py SAMPLE_QUESTIONS rows assert substrings like `- Matches: 19` and hard-code which tool/args the system 'would' call (no LLM actually in the loop). _atdd_review.md Priority 2.
suggestion: Parse answers into small value objects in the driver and assert domain facts/invariants (e.g. wins+draws+losses==matches) rather than presentation.

title: Suite welded to a fixed data snapshot (exact row counts and standings)
evidence: tests/test_data_loader.py:18-24 assert exact raw_counts (4180/1337/1255/10296/6886/18207); many query tests assert exact standings/counts, so any data refresh breaks hundreds of assertions at once.
suggestion: Where practical, exercise query logic against small synthetic fixtures; keep the full-dataset counts as a single explicit snapshot test.

title: Very low token efficiency for this run
evidence: scores.json token_efficiency=0.012703654631041393 — the run consumed a large token/iteration budget (agent log shows multiple red->green fix cycles before 182 passed).
suggestion: Informational cost signal for cross-run comparison; not a defect.

title: Tool surface substantially exceeds the spec minimum
evidence: server.py registers 17 MCP tools + 1 resource (team_overview, team_trend, team_rankings, compare_seasons, knockout_results, derby_matches, player_club_summary, ...) vs the ~11 capability requirements.
suggestion: Enhancement beyond spec; noted, not a deduction.
